About Me

## Hi, I'm Abeer Nasir — the person behind Open Agent.

I started learning about AI in 2023 with one simple question: how can AI help a real business work better? So I learned by building projects and working with real clients — solving real problems, not reading theory.

Today I help stores and small businesses get more customers, save time, and grow. I keep everything simple: you tell me the problem, I fix it, and I explain it in plain English.

Small budgets, honest work. Every plan is built around your budget — not the other way around. Every service comes with a 3-day money-back guarantee, so you're never stuck paying for something that doesn't work for you.

FAQ

## Clear answers to quick questions.
Everything you need to know before we start.

###

What exactly do you do?

I help small businesses and stores grow. I run their ads, manage their social media, and use AI to save them time. Think of me as one person doing the work of a whole marketing team — without the confusing tech talk.

###

How much does it cost?

Each service has its own starting price, based on the work involved. Social Media Management is PKR 15,000, Website and Software Development from PKR 25,000, Meta & Google Ads from PKR 30,000, AI Automation and Content from PKR 40,000, Digital Marketing from PKR 50,000, Generative AI from PKR 65,000, and AI Agent Development from PKR 80,000. Pick the services you need in the pricing section above and the total adds up by itself. I confirm the final amount on a free call — so there are no surprises.

###

For ads — is the ad spend included in the price?

No. For Meta & Google Ads, the price is my management fee — setting up, testing, and optimizing your campaigns. The ad spend itself (the money that goes to Facebook and Google) is separate, and you pay the platforms directly. That keeps everything transparent: you always know what I charge vs. what the platforms charge.

###

I don't know anything about marketing or AI. Is that okay?

That's completely fine — it's my job to handle all of it. You never have to learn any of it. I explain everything in plain English and show you simple reports every week.

###

Will you work with a small budget?

Yes — small budgets are exactly who I built this for. I start small, prove the work, and scale up only when you're ready. My packages are built around your budget, not the other way around.

###

How fast will I see results?

Ads can bring visitors within days, and sales usually follow within weeks. The important thing is that I report every week, so you always know exactly what's happening — no guessing, no surprises.

###

Do you work with businesses outside Pakistan?

Yes. I work fully online with clients anywhere in the world. All you need is WhatsApp or email.

## Social Media Management

Service · Social Media Management

# Social Media Management in Karachi, Pakistan
I plan, write, design, and post your content — and reply to your customers. You stay visible, I do the work. From PKR 15,000/month.

[PKR 15,000 — See Price](https://open-agent.agency/pricing/)
[Book a Free Call](https://open-agent.agency/contact/)

## Why most small businesses in Karachi fail at social media
They open accounts on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok, post for two weeks, and then stop — because there's no plan and no time. Your customers in Pakistan are on these platforms every day, but if your page is quiet, they buy from whoever shows up in their feed. The fix isn't more posting. It's a simple, consistent plan on the right platforms — run by someone who actually does it.

## What you get every month

- A monthly content plan made for your business and city

- Posts written in your voice — no robotic captions

- Designs and images for every post

- Comments and messages replied to, fast

- A simple monthly report: what went out, what worked

## Which platforms should you use?
For most shops in Karachi, that's Facebook and Instagram. For a B2B service in Pakistan, LinkedIn is often a better pick. I help you choose the two where your customers actually are — then I manage those properly. Two platforms, done well, always beat five done badly.

## How it works

- Free first call — we agree on platforms, tone, and goals.

- I build your first month's plan and you approve it.

- I post, reply, and tweak — you watch the page grow.

### Running out of time for social media?
That's exactly what I'm here for. Tell me your problem on a free call and I'll show you how I'd keep your brand visible — without you lifting a finger.

[Chat on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923703159642)
[Email Me](mailto:abeerinfo5566@gmail.com)

FAQ

## Social media questions, answered.

### How much does social media management cost in Karachi?
Social Media Management starts at PKR 15,000 per month. The final amount depends on how many platforms you need and how much content you want. The exact price is confirmed on a free call before any work starts.

### Which platforms do you manage?
Most small businesses in Pakistan do best on Facebook and Instagram. For B2B services, LinkedIn can be a better fit. I recommend the two platforms where your customers actually are, and I manage those properly.

### Can you work with my existing accounts?
Yes. I take over your existing Facebook, Instagram, or TikTok accounts and keep your brand voice. You don't need to change anything.

## Website & Software Development

Service · Website & Software

# A professional website in days, not months
Your website is your shop window. I design and build it fast, clean, and mobile-friendly — so you look professional online without touching any code. From PKR 25,000.

[From PKR 25,000 — See Price](https://open-agent.agency/pricing/)
[Book a Free Call](https://open-agent.agency/contact/)

## Why a small business needs a website in 2026
Before people buy, they check. They look at reviews, they look at photos, and they look for a website. A business with no website looks like it has something to hide — even if it doesn't.

In Karachi and across Pakistan, many small businesses run only on WhatsApp. It works for chatting, but it doesn't build trust. When a customer wants to know your prices, your services, and whether you're real, they go looking for a website. If they find nothing, they buy from the competitor who has one.

A clean, fast website fixes that. It tells customers who you are, what you sell, and how to reach you — in seconds. That trust works the same way in the United States, where buyers expect every business to have a proper online presence.

## What you get
You don't need a huge, complicated site. You need one that looks professional and answers your customers' questions. That's exactly what I build.

- A modern design made for your business

- Works perfectly on phones

- Fast loading — no one waits for a slow page

- Your products, services, prices, and contact info clear

- Basic SEO so people can find you

- Help after launch, whenever you need it

Whether it's one page for a new shop or a few pages for a growing business, the site is built around what your customers actually need to know.

## How it works

- Free first call — we talk about your business and goals

- I share a simple plan and design

- You approve it

- I build it

- You review it

- It goes live — with me available for help after

You're involved at every step, but you never have to do the work. You just say yes or no, and I take it from there.

## How long does it take?
Most small-business websites are ready in 5-10 working days. That's the honest answer. Bigger projects take longer, and we agree on a clear timeline on the first call — before any work starts.

No waiting for months. No endless back and forth. A clear plan, a clear deadline, and a site you're proud to share.

## Do I need technical skills or code?
No. I handle everything — the design, the building, and the launch. You don't need to write a line of code or learn any software.

After launch, I can show you how to make simple updates yourself if you'd like. Or I can do them for you. Either way, you're never stuck.

## Who this is for
New businesses that don't have a site yet. Businesses with old, slow websites that make them look outdated. Shops and services in Karachi, across Pakistan, and in the United States.

If you're proud of what you do but your online presence doesn't show it, this is the fix. A professional website is the simplest way to look as good as your business actually is.

### Your website is old, slow, or missing?
Customers judge your business in seconds. Tell me what you need on a free call, and I'll show you exactly how a fast, clean site would look for your business.

## Meta & Google Ads

Service · Meta & Google Ads

# Meta & Google Ads in Karachi, Pakistan
I set up your ads on Facebook, Instagram, and Google, test what works, and move your budget to the winners. From PKR 30,000 — ad spend is separate.

[From PKR 30,000 — See Price](https://open-agent.agency/pricing/)
[Book a Free Call](https://open-agent.agency/contact/)

## Why most small businesses lose money on ads
Running ads isn't the hard part. Running them well is. Most small businesses in Karachi lose money on ads for the same simple reasons: no plan, no testing, and stopping too early. They put money on Facebook and Instagram without knowing who to target or what message will work. The platform spends their budget on the wrong people, nothing happens, and they give up — then say ads don't work. The problem isn't ads. It's how they're set up.

The same story repeats for small businesses in the United States, just with a bigger budget and more competition. A small shop in the US can burn through hundreds of dollars in a week if the targeting and the offer are weak. The platforms are happy to take the money either way. Someone has to make sure every rupee and dollar is pointed at people who might actually buy.

This is where a plan comes in. Before we spend anything, we decide who you're selling to, what you're offering, and how we'll measure success. Then we test small, find what works, and put more budget behind it.

## What you get
You don't get a login and a pat on the back. You get a person running your campaigns properly. Here's what that looks like:

- Campaign setup on Facebook, Instagram, and Google — the platforms your customers actually use

- Audience targeting based on location, interests, and behavior — no guessing

- Ad copy and creative written for your business, not a template

- Daily checks and small tweaks to keep costs down and results up

- A/B testing, so we know which headline, image, and audience really work

- Clear reports: what was spent, what sold, and what we'll do next

- Landing page advice, because a good ad sent to a weak page still wastes money

## How it works

- Free first call — we talk about your business, your budget, and your goal.

- Strategy and setup, days 1 to 7 — I build your campaigns, audiences, and ads, and you approve everything before launch.

- Launch and test, week 2 — campaigns go live and we start learning what works.

- Daily optimization and weekly reports — I adjust what's underperforming and send you a plain-English update.

## Ad spend is separate — here's exactly what that means
My fee covers the management: strategy, setup, ad creative, testing, and daily optimization. The money that actually goes to Facebook and Google is separate. You pay that directly to the platforms, and you approve it before it's spent. There are no hidden charges and no surprise bills. You always know where your money is going.

This is standard practice, and it's the honest way to run ads. I never mark up your ad spend, and I never get a cut of what you pay the platforms. My only income is the management fee — so my incentive is simple: make your campaigns work.

## How fast will you see results?
Here's an honest answer: no one can promise sales in a week. What I can promise is fast, honest feedback. In the first 1 to 2 weeks you'll see real data — how many people saw your ads, clicked, and took action. That tells us what's working and what needs fixing.

For most small businesses in Pakistan and the US, meaningful results show up in 2 to 4 weeks: more messages, more calls, more orders. Campaigns that perform well get more budget. Campaigns that don't get changed or paused. The faster we learn, the faster you win.

## What is an AI agent?
An AI agent is software that does a real job by itself. It reads, updates, and replies — using your data and your rules. Think of it as a worker, not a chatbot. A chatbot waits on your website and answers customer questions. An agent gets on with work: checking orders, filling in spreadsheets, sending messages, and building reports.

You decide what it can and can't do. Nothing runs without your approval. You set the rules once, and it follows them the same way every time — no missed steps, no forgotten follow-ups. That consistency is the real value. Your customers get faster replies, and your team gets its time back.

## Who needs a custom AI agent?
Growing businesses in Pakistan and the United States whose team is drowning in repetitive work. Orders typed into a spreadsheet by hand. Stock levels that never get updated. Reports that eat an hour every morning. Follow-ups that don't happen because there's no time.

Here's how to tell if you're a candidate. If the same three tasks take up your team's mornings every day, you're a candidate. If you keep two spreadsheets because nobody trusts the first one, you're a candidate. If orders get lost between WhatsApp and your records, you're a candidate. It doesn't matter if you run a shop in Karachi, a clinic in Lahore, or a service business in the United States — if you copy data between apps every day, an agent can take that off your plate.

## What you get
Here's what a build includes.

- A custom agent built around your exact workflow

- Connects to your tools — spreadsheets, store, email, WhatsApp

- Automation that saves hours every week

- Safety checks so it only does what you approve

- Tested and working before you pay

- I'm available after launch for changes

You stay in control the whole time. Before the agent touches your real data, you test it on your own terms and approve exactly what it is allowed to do.

## Real examples of the work it can do
These are the jobs business owners actually hand over.

- Reads incoming WhatsApp or email orders and adds them to your spreadsheet

- Updates inventory when a sale happens

- Sends a daily sales report every morning

- Follows up with leads who went quiet

- Pulls data from your store and answers your team's questions

Here's one example in real life. An order comes in on WhatsApp at 9pm. The agent reads it, adds the items to your sheet, checks stock, and confirms back to the customer. By morning, your spreadsheet is ready and your customer is happy — and no one had to stay up to do it.

## How it works
The process is simple, and you're in control the whole way.

- Free first call to map your workflow

- I design the agent and show you the plan

- Build and test with your real data

- You review the work

- It goes live, with support after

## How long does it take?
Honest answer: most agents take 2 to 4 weeks from the first call to going live. It depends on how many tools the agent needs to connect to. A simple agent that reads orders into one spreadsheet is faster than one that talks to your store, your email, and WhatsApp together.

I give you a clear timeline before any work starts, so you always know where things stand. You see the plan before I build anything, and you test the work before you pay.

## Is this the same as the ready-made chatbot?
No. The ready-made [AI assistant](https://open-agent.agency/services/ai-agent/), which starts at PKR 40,000, answers customer questions out of the box. It's a fast, affordable start for businesses whose customers ask the same questions again and again.

This service is a custom build. It does behind-the-scenes work with your own data and tools — reading, updating, and reporting. If customers are asking the same questions, the ready-made assistant is probably enough. If your team is buried in repetitive tasks, this is the one you want. Many businesses start with the ready-made assistant and grow into a custom build later.

## What is generative AI content?
Generative AI is a tool that can write text and make images in seconds. Type a request — "write an Instagram caption for a bakery in Karachi" — and it drafts something in moments. The same tool can describe your products, draft your ads, and create visuals to go with them.

The important part: AI doesn't replace judgment. Everything it makes gets checked by a human — me — before it touches your customers. You get the speed of a machine and the quality check of a person.

## Why most businesses pay too much for content
Small businesses pay too much for content in three ways. They pay a freelancer per piece, then wait days for a draft that needs re-edits. The quality swings from one post to the next. Some go the other way and publish raw AI content — and it shows, with robotic language and wrong details.

AI removes the wait without removing the quality check. I write the instructions, the AI drafts fast, and I edit, fact-check, and shape everything into your brand voice. You get more content, faster, for a fraction of the old cost.

## What you get

- Ad copy for Meta and Google that's built to get clicks

- Product descriptions that sell without sounding salesy

- Social media posts and captions in your brand voice

- Images and designs for your posts and ads

- Email and WhatsApp messages your customers actually read

- Content that matches your brand voice — not a generic template

## How it works

- AI drafts are created fast — most content lands in your inbox within a day or two.

- You approve or ask for changes — your call on everything.

- Final files delivered, ready to publish anywhere.

## Is AI content any good?
Honest answer: it's as good as the person directing it. AI by itself can produce bland, generic filler. But when it's guided by someone who knows copywriting and knows your business, the results are sharp, clear, and human-sounding.

That's the value I add. I don't just press a button. I write the strategy, shape the output, and polish every piece. The difference between AI content that helps your business and AI content that hurts it is the human in the middle.

Privacy Policy

# Your data. Plain English.
Last updated: August 3, 2026. This page explains what I collect, why, and how it's protected.

## 1. Who is responsible
This website (open-agent.agency) is run by **Abeer Nasir** (Open Agent), a digital marketing and AI specialist based in Karachi, Pakistan. If you have any question about this policy, message me on WhatsApp at +92 370 3159642 or email abeerinfo5566@gmail.com.

## 2. What information I collect
When you use the contact form or the pricing calculator, the information you send — such as your **name, phone number, email address, chosen service, budget, and store or website link** — goes directly to my WhatsApp or email. I only keep what you choose to share.

I do **not** ask for or store payment details on this website. No account is required to browse the site.

## 3. How I use your information

- To reply to your messages and answer your questions.

### Social Media Made Simple for Small Businesses
- Category: Social · Published: 2026-02-18 · Read time: 4 min read
- URL: https://open-agent.agency/blog-post/?post=social-media

You don't need to post every day or be on every app. A simple plan on two platforms is enough. Here is the easy way.

You don't need to post every day. You don't need to be on every app. You need one simple plan on the two places where your customers actually spend their time. That's it.

#### Pick two platforms, not five

Most small businesses fail at social media because they try to do everything. They open accounts on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and more — then give up after a month because it's too much. The fix is simple: pick the two platforms where your customers are. For most shops in Pakistan, that's Facebook and Instagram. For a B2B service, it might be LinkedIn and WhatsApp. Two platforms, done well, always beat five done badly.

#### A simple content plan

You don't need a content calendar that looks like a science project. Start with three kinds of posts: show your product, share a customer story, and answer one question people keep asking you. That's the whole plan. Show what you sell. Show that real people are happy with it. Show that you can be trusted. Keep this rhythm going, and people will start to remember your name — so when they need what you sell, they come to you first.

#### Reply fast — that's the real game

The people who reply fastest win. When someone sends a message or leaves a comment, answer within the hour if you can. Many small businesses reply the next day, and by then the customer has already bought from someone else. You don't need a big team for this — you need speed. A quick 'Yes, we have it in stock' can be the difference between a sale and a lost customer.

#### The bottom line

Social media isn't complicated. Two platforms. Three kinds of posts. Fast replies. If that still sounds like work you don't have time for, that's exactly what I do — I run the whole thing for you, starting at PKR 15,000 a month. You stay visible, I do the work.

### Small-Budget Ads: Get Sales Without Burning Cash
- Category: Ads · Published: 2026-03-05 · Read time: 4 min read
- URL: https://open-agent.agency/blog-post/?post=small-budget-ads

You don't need a big ad budget to see results. You need the right setup. Here is how to start small and win.

You hear stories of brands spending big money on ads and making big money back. So you think: ads are for large companies with large budgets. That's wrong. Small budgets can win — but only if you set up your ads the right way from day one.

#### Small budget, one job

When you have a small budget, your ads have to do one job, not three. Don't try to make people aware of your brand, learn about you, and buy from you all at once. Pick one goal: a purchase. Send people to a page built to sell. If you split a small budget across 'brand awareness', 'traffic', and 'sales', every campaign gets too little money to learn anything.

#### Start with the people who already know you

Your easiest sales will always come from people who already know you. So start there: send your first small budget to people who visited your website, who follow your page, or who bought before. These people need less convincing, so your money goes further. Once you see a few sales, let the ad platform find more people who look like them.

#### Watch the number that matters

Most beginners stare at likes and comments. Those feel good, but they don't pay the bills. Watch the number that matters: how much it costs you to get one sale. If one sale costs more than you earn on that sale, stop and fix the ad or the page. Don't pour in more money and hope. A small budget wins when the setup is right and every rupee has one clear job.

#### The bottom line

You don't need a big budget. You need a clear goal, the right audience, and one number you watch. That's the whole game. If you want help setting it up right the first time, that's what I do — Meta and Google ads starting at PKR 30,000.

### What Is an AI Agent? (And Do You Even Need One?)
- Category: AI · Published: 2026-03-20 · Read time: 4 min read
- URL: https://open-agent.agency/blog-post/?post=ai-agent

You keep hearing about AI agents. Here is what they actually do — and how to know if your business needs one.

Everyone is talking about AI agents, and it sounds complicated. It isn't. Here is the simplest way to think about it: an AI agent is a worker that never sleeps, never takes a break, and never gets bored of answering the same question.

#### What an AI agent actually does

You give it your information — your products, your prices, your rules. Then your customers can talk to it on WhatsApp, Facebook, or your website. It answers their questions in seconds, any time of day or night. When it doesn't know something, it sends the conversation to a real person. Think of it as your front desk, working 24 hours a day.

#### Do you even need one?

Ask yourself three questions. Do customers ask you the same questions again and again? Do you reply late because you're busy? Do you lose sales when people message you at night? If you answered yes to any of these, an AI agent will quickly pay for itself. If customers never message you and you have all the time in the world, you can skip it for now.

#### What it is not

An AI agent is not magic, and it won't fix a bad product or a rude attitude. It can't have deep conversations about feelings. But for the everyday stuff — 'Is this in stock?', 'How long is delivery?', 'What sizes do you have?' — it's faster and cheaper than hiring someone to sit and answer the phone all day.

#### The bottom line

If your business gets the same questions over and over, an AI agent saves you time and catches sales you'd otherwise miss at night. I set these up starting at PKR 40,000 — ready to plug into WhatsApp, Facebook, or your website.

A ready-made agent answers your customers. A custom agent does your work. Here is what happens behind the scenes.

A ready-made AI agent answers your customers. A custom AI agent does your work. If you want to know which one your business needs, keep reading — this is about the agents that work behind the scenes while you run your business.

#### The boring work is the best place to start

Look at your week. Copying numbers into a report. Sending the same follow-up message to every lead. Moving order details from one app to another. None of this needs a human brain — it's just work that has to happen. A custom AI agent can do it while you sleep, without complaining and without mistakes.

#### What a custom agent looks like

It depends on your business. For one store, it reads every new order, sends each customer their tracking number, and adds the order to a spreadsheet. For a service business, it takes every new lead, sends a friendly first message, and reminds them politely if they don't reply. For a team, it collects numbers from different places and sends one clean report every morning. You tell me the job, I build the worker.

#### It connects to the tools you already use

You don't need to change anything about how you work. Your agent can work with your spreadsheets, your online store, your email, and your WhatsApp. It does the same steps a good employee would do — it just never sleeps, never takes a day off, and never makes a typo at 1am.

### Digital Marketing in Plain English: A Beginner's Guide
- Category: Marketing · Published: 2026-04-16 · Read time: 4 min read
- URL: https://open-agent.agency/blog-post/?post=digital-marketing

Digital marketing sounds big and scary. It isn't. It's just four simple pieces — and you don't need to learn any of them.

Digital marketing sounds big and scary. It isn't. At its heart, it's just one simple idea: get in front of the people who want what you sell, and make it easy for them to buy.

#### The four pieces

Almost all digital marketing is four things: ads (paying to be seen), social media (being seen without paying), content (showing you can be trusted), and your website (where people actually buy). That's it. The confusion comes when people throw around words like 'funnels' and 'ROAS' and 'engagement rates'. Behind the fancy words, it's still just these four pieces.

#### Why most small businesses fail at it

They do a bit of everything, with no plan, and give up when nothing works after two weeks. Digital marketing is not a light switch. It's a slow cooker. Ads can bring people fast, but trust takes time. The businesses that win are the ones who stay consistent for months — not the ones who panic after a week.

#### You don't need to learn it all

This is the part most people miss. You don't need to become an expert. You need one person who knows what they're doing, and a plan you can understand. If I explain my strategy and it sounds like a different language, that's a bad sign. You should always understand what's happening with your money.

#### The bottom line

Digital marketing is ads, social media, content, and a website — done together, with a plan, over time. If you'd rather run your business than learn marketing, I can run the whole thing for you, starting at PKR 50,000.

Generative AI can write, make pictures, and create ideas in seconds. It sounds like a gimmick, so let me show you where it genuinely helps a small business — not the hype, just the useful parts.

### Why Your Meta Ads Are Burning Budget (And How AI Fixes It)
- Category: Ads · Published: 2026-05-21 · Read time: 4 min read
- URL: https://open-agent.agency/blog-post/?post=meta-ads

Most stores waste ad money on the wrong audience. Here is how AI finds the right buyer faster — and cuts your cost per sale.

In Pakistan, most stores treat Meta ads like a lottery. They top up PKR 50,000, pick an audience that says 'interested in fashion,' and hit publish. When the money runs out, they blame the algorithm. The algorithm is not the problem. The problem is that you handed it a guessing game instead of a buying signal.

#### The real reason your cost per sale is climbing

Broad audiences stopped working when tracking changed. Meta simply has less data, so it spends your budget learning who NOT to show the ad to. An ad set targeting 'women 18–45, Pakistan, interested in shopping' covers tens of millions of people, and most of them are not buying today. That is why results get expensive every week: the machine is paying to guess. A store that gives Meta clean signals runs differently — a pixel tracking only purchase-ready actions, a lookalike built from real customers, and two or three creative winners instead of ten bored variations. With the same budget, the algorithm now hunts for people who behave like your buyers, and cost per sale usually drops.

#### What AI actually changes

AI does not make a bad product sell. What it does is run the optimization loop no human can keep up with. It watches every ad's results, moves budget to the creative that is winning, and pauses the one that is not — daily, not weekly. It also scores your customer list and feeds your best buyers back into Meta as custom audiences, so the machine learns from every single sale.

#### Three fixes you can make this week

One: install the Meta pixel and track one clear event — purchases, not page views. Two: stop stacking interests and let the audience learn from your customer list. Three: commit to a few creative tests a week and let the numbers pick a winner. On a small budget, run one focused ad set instead of spreading your money across five. One campaign with a signal always beats five without one.

#### The bottom line

Burning budget is a signal, not a sentence. If your ads are expensive, the fix is almost always structure and signals — not more money. That is the system I run for stores in Karachi and across Pakistan: AI doing the testing, you watching the cost per sale drop. Book a call and I will show you what your account looks like through that lens.

### SEO for D2C: Get Found Before Your Competitors Do
- Category: SEO · Published: 2026-06-11 · Read time: 4 min read
- URL: https://open-agent.agency/blog-post/?post=seo-d2c

Your customers are searching right now. If your store is not on page one, a competitor takes the sale.

Think about the last search you made before buying something. 'Best running shoes under 10k.' 'Skincare for oily skin in Pakistan.' 'Where to buy [product] in Lahore.' Every one of those is a sale in progress, and the person clicks the store that answers first. If your store is not on page one, that customer buys from a competitor who is — without ever seeing your brand.

#### SEO is the cheapest customer you will ever get

A Meta click costs money every single time, and you pay again tomorrow to get another one. An SEO click costs nothing: the visitor found you because your page answered their question. That is why stores with even a small search presence keep selling while their ad budget is paused. And in Pakistan, where most online stores have done little SEO, ranking for a few product terms can put you ahead of almost every competitor in your niche.

#### The three pages that actually rank

Category pages win the 'best [product] in Pakistan' searches. Product pages win '[product] price in Pakistan' searches — the highest-intent searches a buyer can type. Blog posts win the 'how to choose' and 'what is the difference' questions that happen right before the purchase. Most stores skip all three, spend on ads, and then wonder why the ads are the only thing bringing sales.

#### What to do in the next 30 days

Fix the basics first: fast hosting, clean URLs, one heading per page, and a title that puts your keyword and city in front. Then write product descriptions that answer real questions — size, material, delivery, warranty — instead of 'premium quality, best price.' Publish two category pages and one buying guide. Set up Google Search Console, which is free and tells you exactly which searches your store already appears for and where you rank.

#### The bottom line

You do not need to outspend your competitors — you need to show up where they are not. Start with the pages that match what buyers actually type, and the traffic compounds while your ad spend stays flat. I help stores in Karachi build exactly this, one page at a time.

### How to Automate Your Store's Busywork
- Category: Automation · Published: 2026-06-25 · Read time: 5 min read
- URL: https://open-agent.agency/blog-post/?post=automation

Order updates. Support replies. Daily reports. Your team does these by hand — and loses hours every week. Here is the fix.

Every week your team answers the same WhatsApp messages — 'Where is my order?' — retypes the same tracking numbers, and copies the same figures into a report. For a store doing thirty orders a day, that adds up to many hours a week of work a machine can finish in seconds. That is not small stuff. That is a part-time salary disappearing into copy-paste.

#### Where your hours actually go

Three tasks eat most store teams alive: order updates and tracking numbers, support replies about status and returns, and daily reports for the owner. None of them need a human judgment call. Each one is a repeatable sequence — exactly what automation is built for. When I audit a store, these three usually account for most of the manual work.

#### The three automations to start with

Order updates: connect your store's order feed to WhatsApp or email, and send the tracking number automatically the moment an order is fulfilled. Support replies: give a small AI agent your most common questions — order status, size guide, return policy — and let it answer in seconds, escalating only when it cannot. Daily reports: have the system pull orders, revenue, and cost per acquisition into one WhatsApp message every morning, before you even ask.

That's the setup I build for stores in Karachi and across Pakistan: order updates send themselves, the AI agent answers the common questions on its own, and the owner gets the morning report before asking for it. Weekly manual work drops to a fraction of what it was — your team gets time back for the parts that actually need a person.

#### What automation cannot replace

Judgment calls: refunds with a story, an angry VIP customer, a pricing decision. Automate the repetitive majority, and your team finally gets time for the part that actually needs a person — which is also the part that builds the brand. The busywork was never your business. It was just the tax you paid for not having a system.

### WhatsApp Business Marketing: A Simple Guide
- Category: Social · Published: 2026-08-04 · Read time: 7 min read
- URL: https://open-agent.agency/blog-post/?post=whatsapp-business

Learn to sell more on WhatsApp with a free profile, catalog, quick replies, and labels. In plain English, for small businesses in Pakistan and the US.

In Pakistan, WhatsApp is not just another app. It's where your customers actually live. They open it dozens of times a day, and when they want to buy something, they message the seller first. Most businesses use WhatsApp only to answer questions. The smart ones use it to sell. This guide shows you the simple system — free tools, messages that work, and the mistakes to avoid.

#### Why WhatsApp — not email, not Facebook

Email is basically dead for most small businesses in Pakistan. A Facebook post is seen by a small fraction of your followers. But a WhatsApp message sits right next to messages from family and friends. It feels personal, it feels trusted, and it gets answered. That's why shops that chat on WhatsApp close more sales than shops that wait for website orders. The reply rate is faster than email, the open rate is higher than any ad, and none of it costs you a rupee. For a small business, no other channel builds this much trust for free.

#### Start with the free WhatsApp Business app

You do not need the paid version to start. The free WhatsApp Business app has everything a small shop needs. It's a separate app from your personal WhatsApp, made for selling. Install it on the phone you already have, and you can also use it on your computer. Skip the paid Business API for now — that's for bigger operations and costs money per message. Start free, and upgrade only when your business genuinely outgrows the free app. Most shops never do.

#### Fill your business profile like it's your shopfront

Your profile is the first thing a customer sees before you say a single word. A half-filled profile looks like a hobby, not a business. Fill it properly: your real business name, a clean logo or photo, your address, your website, your business hours, and one line about what you do. This takes fifteen minutes once, and it quietly builds trust every day after that. When a customer sees a complete, professional profile, they feel safe handing over their money. When they see a blank one, they hesitate — and hesitation is where sales die.

#### Put your best products in the catalog

The catalog is the most underused tool on WhatsApp Business. It's a mini store inside the app. Add your top ten to fifteen products with a clean photo, a short description, and your price in rupees. When a customer asks 'do you have this in stock?', you send the catalog item instead of typing a paragraph. No more blurry screenshots of a price list. The catalog makes you look organized, and it answers half the questions before they are even asked. For home-based shops, the catalog often replaces a website completely.

#### Set up quick replies and away messages

Every day you type the same answers: 'yes, it's available', 'what's your location?', 'how long is delivery?', 'send me your price list'. Quick replies save these as shortcuts, so you answer with two taps instead of typing it out for the fiftieth time. Set an away message for the hours you sleep, so nobody waits in silence. Set a greeting for the first message from a new customer, so they always get a warm start. These small setups take twenty minutes once and save you hours every single week.

#### Use labels so no lead slips away

Every chat is a customer waiting to be sorted. Labels are a free filing system: New Lead, Hot Lead, Asked Price, Order Placed, COD Pending, Repeat Customer. When a chat has a label, you know exactly what to do next — and you never forget to follow up on a hot lead. This is the difference between hoping and knowing. Shops that label their chats close more sales because nothing falls through the cracks. It takes ten minutes a day, and it turns your WhatsApp from a messy inbox into a sales desk.

#### Build your list the right way

A small list of real buyers beats a big list of strangers. Grow your list with people who actually want to hear from you. Put a 'Chat on WhatsApp' button on your website and your Facebook page. Add your number to receipts and delivery notes. Ask happy customers if you can send them offers. Never buy numbers and never copy them from Facebook groups — it breaks WhatsApp's rules, it wastes your time, and it can get your account banned for good. Permission is the whole game. A customer who chose to be on your list will read your messages; one who didn't will block you.

#### Send broadcasts people actually read

A broadcast sends one message to many people at once. Done badly, it gets you blocked. Done well, it makes you money. Send two to four broadcasts a month — not one a day. Make most of them useful: a tip, a new arrival, a behind-the-scenes look, a customer story. Use promotions sparingly. A simple rule: seven helpful messages for every three sales messages. And never broadcast to people who didn't save your number or agree to receive updates. Someone who blocks you is a customer you can never reach again — protect your list like it's your most valuable asset, because it is.

#### Mistakes that get you banned

A handful of habits can cost you your WhatsApp account — and with it, every customer you built. Sending the same message to thousands of strangers. Buying a list of numbers. Using words like 'URGENT 90% OFF' and 'earn lakhs from home' in bulk. Forwarding spam. All of these can get your number flagged, then banned. Pakistan's telecom authority is cracking down on bulk messaging too, so the risk is real. The safe rule: only message people who know you, keep broadcasts small and rare, and never buy lists. One honest, growing list is worth a million random numbers.

#### Post on Status for free advertising

Status is the most ignored free tool on WhatsApp, and it's a gift. The people who saved your number see your Status when they open the app. Post a photo of your new stock, a short video of your product, or a picture of a happy customer. A few times a week is plenty. Keep it simple: one clear photo, one short line, your number. You stay in front of your customers all week without spending a single rupee. For a small business, Status is free advertising that actually gets seen.

#### Reply fast — the sales trick most shops miss

The business that replies fastest wins. When a customer messages you at 11pm and you answer at 11am, they have already bought from someone else. Speed is free trust. If you can't be available all day, set an away message that says when you'll reply, and let the greeting message keep the conversation warm. For many small shops, a simple 'yes, it's available, I'll keep it for you' answered within the hour is worth more than a month of paid ads. Fast replies turn browsers into buyers.

#### The follow-up that turns 'maybe' into a sale

Most sales are lost in the silence after 'I'll think about it'. A short, polite follow-up the next day saves them: 'Hi, just checking if you had any questions about the product. I can hold it for you till tomorrow.' No pressure, no tricks — just a nudge. Use your labels to find the people who asked about a product but didn't order, and follow up with them once. You'll be surprised how many were waiting for exactly that message. One gentle follow-up a day brings back more sales than a week of shouting promotions.

#### When you outgrow the free app

The free app is enough for most small businesses. When your chats grow beyond one person, when orders get complicated, or when you want to send order updates automatically, it's time to move up. The WhatsApp Business API lets multiple people answer the same number, sends automatic order and tracking updates, and can run an AI assistant that answers common questions at night. Click-to-WhatsApp ads on Facebook and Instagram are also powerful here — someone taps your ad and lands straight in your chat, ready to talk. This is the stage where a little setup saves you hours every week.

#### Your first 30 days on WhatsApp Business

Here is a plan you can copy. Week one: install the app, fill your profile, and add your top ten products to the catalog. Week two: set up quick replies, a greeting, and an away message, then start labeling every new chat. Week three: put a 'Chat on WhatsApp' button on your website and your Facebook page, and add your number to your receipts. Week four: send your first broadcast to people who know you — one useful message, not a sales push. Then post a Status a few times a week, and follow up once with anyone who asked a price but didn't order. That's the whole system, and it costs nothing but a little time. Do this for a month and you'll have a sales machine most shops in your city still don't have.

#### The bottom line
